text: {"question":"Which observational data combination in the study demonstrates that the variable‑curvature model shows a decelerated phase close to redshift z = 0, and how is this evidenced in the results?","reference_answer":"The combined Cosmic Chronometers and Type Ia supernovae data (CC+SNIa) produce a deceleration parameter q(z) that rises above zero near z ≈ 0, indicating a decelerated expansion phase for the variable‑curvature model, as shown in the q(z) plots of the results section."}
